items.title_zh: PayPal 联合创始人彼得 · 蒂尔：后乔布斯时代的苹果“就没再拿出什么新东西”
items.title_en: Peter Thiel Says Apple Hasn't Made Anything New Since Steve Jobs
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 25 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天（25 日）凌晨报道，PayPal 联合创始人、亿万富翁兼科技投资人彼得 · 蒂尔认为，自苹果创始人史蒂夫 · 乔布斯于 2011 年因癌症去世以来，苹果的大多数举措 都没能让自己眼前一亮 。 蒂尔接受作家沃尔特 · 艾萨克森采访时直言：“在我看来，乔布斯去世后， 苹果就没再拿出什么新东西 。事实证明，手机确实是一项了不起的发明，但之后也没多少事情可做了。接下来的 15 年左右，无非就是 扩大规模、经营品牌，不断完善已有的产品 。” 报道称，苹果一直受到“缺乏创新”的批评，尤其是在手机和平板电脑之外未能取得新的突破。进入 AI 时代后，苹果的 Siri 语音助手也落后于 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的竞争产品。不过，苹果的产品依然广受欢迎。MacBook 是不少 AI 爱好者和普通用户的首选笔记本电脑，iPhone 随处可见，AirPods 自 2016 年问世以来，也凭借简洁时尚的设计受到消费者青睐。 早在 2017 年，蒂尔就曾向《纽约时报》记者莫琳 · 多德断言， 苹果的时代已经结束 。但从那时起，苹果股价一直稳步上涨。 IT之家从报道中获悉，蒂尔并未全盘否定苹果。他认为苹果是 一只“经营良好的纯粹价值股” ，只是对乔布斯去世后苹果失去长远眼光感到惋惜。“从某种意义上说，我仍然认为埃隆 · 马斯克或史蒂夫 · 乔布…
items.summary_en: PayPal co-founder and investor Peter Thiel told Walter Isaacson that Apple has not “come up with anything new” since Steve Jobs died in 2011, saying the post-iPhone era has largely been about scaling, brand management and refining existing products. He still called Apple a “well-run pure value stock” but lamented its loss of long-term vision. The report also notes criticism that Apple’s Siri lags OpenAI and Anthropic in the AI era, even as its products remain popular.
items.why_zh: 作为知名科技投资人，蒂尔对苹果创新力的尖锐评价，折射出外界对苹果在 AI 时代是否还能推出突破性产品的持续质疑。
items.why_en: Thiel’s blunt critique highlights persistent doubts over whether Apple can still deliver breakthrough products in the AI era.

items.title_zh: PHP 基金会负责人坦言资金不足：仅 1 名全职员工
items.title_en: PHP Foundation Head Says Funding Is Tight With Only One Full-Time Employee
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 25 日消息，本周，PHP 曝出两处高危漏洞，全球随即紧急行动，保护网站免遭黑客攻击。这件事也让人们看到，这门已有三十年历史的开源编程语言，对互联网而言有多重要。 据估算，全球最高有约七成网站依托 PHP 搭建，但负责维护 PHP 的非营利基金会，经费却十分紧张。 PHP 基金会执行董事伊丽莎白 · 巴伦（Elizabeth Barron）在当地时间周五的邮件采访中表示：“我们只有一名全职员工，也就是我，另外还有十四名大多是兼职的外包人员。”基金会董事会成员都是无薪志愿者，资金来源依靠捐赠与资助。 IT之家注意到，基金会和外部研究人员以及多家企业合作，其中包括 OpenAI、网络安全公司 Wiz 和 Calif，共同排查安全漏洞、协调补丁开发，本周三发布的修复补丁就是这项合作的成果。 网络安全服务商 Cloudflare 称已经监测到数百万次攻击尝试，不过巴伦表示，基金会没有证据表明黑客在漏洞公开前就成功利用这些漏洞，或是攻击已经打好补丁的网站。 她说：“我们和 OpenAI、Wiz、Calif 在这个问题上密切协作，几家机构都没有反馈已修复系统出现异常的情况。” 人工智能对基金会而言，既是助力，也是负担。这些潜伏了十年的漏洞，正是借助人工智能才被研究人员发现，巴伦也提到，AI 提升了程序员的工作效率。 但与此同时，维护人员的工作量也因此增加。现在 PHP 项目…
items.summary_en: After two high-severity PHP vulnerabilities triggered urgent patching worldwide this week, the PHP Foundation’s executive director, Elizabeth Barron, said the nonprofit has only one full-time employee—herself—plus 14 mostly part-time contractors, with an unpaid volunteer board and funding from donations and grants. The foundation worked with OpenAI, Wiz and Calif on fixes. Cloudflare saw millions of attack attempts, but Barron said there is no evidence the flaws were exploited before disclosure. AI helped find decade-old bugs and boost productivity, but also added maintenance workload.
items.why_zh: 约七成网站依赖 PHP，而维护它的基金会人手和经费如此紧张，暴露出关键开源基础设施的可持续性风险。
items.why_en: With roughly 70% of websites relying on PHP, the foundation’s thin staffing and funding expose sustainability risks in critical open-source infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 开源项目 GPU Unlock 可释放英伟达 RTX 30 系列显卡隐藏 AI 算力，实际性能提升可达 60%
items.title_en: Open-Source GPU Unlock Project Unlocks Hidden AI Compute on RTX 30 Series, With Up to 60% Gains in Some Workloads
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 25 日消息，英伟达已经上市一段时间的 GeForce RTX 30 系列（代号安培，Ampere）显卡，显然还有大量尚未释放的计算潜力。GitHub 用户扎吉塔（Zagitta）开发了一款名为 GPU Unlock 的开源新项目，可以解除安培架构显卡上部分人为设置的性能限制，在特定负载下，张量核心的计算吞吐量几乎可以翻倍，而且不需要修改英伟达驱动，也不用永久刷写显卡的 VBIOS。 IT之家注意到，这个项目专门针对一项指令发射速率限制：在使用 FP32 累加的 FP16/BF16 张量核心运算中，消费级安培显卡的运行速率相比专业卡更低。解除这项限制之后，工具就能释放显卡硬件本身就具备的额外计算性能。 有意思的是，GPU Unlock 建立在早前针对英伟达 CMP 加密货币挖矿显卡的相关研究之上。它把 CMP 项目的固件解锁技术和一套提前初始化方案结合起来，依靠一个 Linux 内核模块，在英伟达显卡驱动加载之前执行操作。该模块修改对应的硬件速度选择寄存器，执行一次功能级重置（FLR），之后原版驱动就可以正常初始化显卡。 这也意味着用户每次更新驱动新版本时，都不用再给驱动打补丁。开发者目前标注支持 GA102、GA103、GA104、GA106 型号 GPU，覆盖了 RTX 30 系列里的大部分型号，不过并不是每一张显卡都一定能兼容，也不保证都能获得性能提升。…
items.summary_en: An open-source project called GPU Unlock, developed by GitHub user Zagitta, claims to remove some artificial performance limits on Nvidia RTX 30-series (Ampere) cards, nearly doubling tensor-core throughput in certain workloads and delivering up to 60% real-world gains without modifying Nvidia drivers or permanently flashing VBIOS. It targets a lower instruction issue rate on consumer Ampere cards for FP16/BF16 tensor-core operations with FP32 accumulation, using a Linux kernel module before driver load to modify a hardware speed-select register and perform a function-level reset. It lists support for GA102, GA103, GA104 and GA106, but compatibility and gains are not guaranteed for every card.
items.why_zh: 如果该方案稳定有效，可能让大量消费级 RTX 30 系显卡免费获得额外 AI 算力，但也引发对稳定性、保修和硬件限制合理性的讨论。
items.why_en: If stable and effective, it could give many consumer RTX 30-series cards extra AI compute for free, while raising questions about reliability, warranties and the rationale for hardware limits.

items.title_zh: 宾夕法尼亚州要求AI生成广告必须加标注
items.title_en: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
items.summary_zh: 宾夕法尼亚州州长 Josh Shapiro 于周四签署《人工智能欺骗性广告法》，要求对由人工智能生成或显著修改的广告进行披露。该法适用于静态图片、视频、音频和文字等各类广告形式，且标注须采用与广告本身相同的载体格式——这意味着从大型企业的电视广告到小餐馆的促销传单都在覆盖范围内。宾州是全美最早对AI内容强制披露立法的州之一。此举被视为对AI伪造内容在商业宣传中泛滥的回应，也可能为其他州的立法提供范本。
items.summary_en: On Thursday, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act into law, requiring disclosures on AI-generated ads. The law requires any ad - whether it's a still image, video, audio, or text - that "has been significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence" to include a label in the same format as the ad itself. That applies to TV commercials from multi-billion-dollar companies , as well as restaurants' ugly, crowded flyers about their wing specials. Pennsylvania is one of the first states to require disclosures on AI content. And it…
items.why_zh: 这是美国州层面较早落地的AI内容强制标注立法，可能推动其他州跟进并改变广告业的合规流程。
items.why_en: It is one of the earliest state-level mandates for AI content disclosure in the US, potentially prompting other states to follow and reshaping ad-industry compliance.

items.why_zh: MCP 正成为连接AI助手与企业数据的事实标准之一，此类工具化产品有助于数据基础薄弱的中型企业更快落地AI应用。
items.why_en: MCP is emerging as a de facto standard for linking AI assistants to enterprise data, helping midmarket firms with limited data infrastructure adopt AI more quickly.

items.summary_en: China's Academy of ICT (CAICT) says domestic daily token consumption reached about 500 trillion in June 2026, nearly four times the December 2025 level. It released a 2026 token service performance monitoring report based on January-August data, comparing official vendor platforms with third-party hosting of DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM and Kimi across success rate, throughput, first-token latency, stability, price and context window.
items.why_zh: 词元消耗量是衡量大模型真实落地规模的硬指标，而性能监测报告为用户选型提供了统一参照。
items.why_en: Token consumption is a hard gauge of real-world LLM adoption, and the benchmark report gives buyers a common basis for choosing services.

items.title_en: ByteDance Merges AI Short-Drama Platform Xiaoyunque Into Jimeng, Keeping Separate Entry
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，据 36 氪今日报道，字节跳动内部近期完成了一次业务整合，AI 短剧创作平台小云雀并入智能创作平台即梦，产品仍保留独立入口。 此次调整以资源整合为主，即梦已经接入小云雀的短剧相关能力。调整后，小云雀的运营由即梦运营和市场负责人陈欣然负责，产品团队没有变化。 小云雀和即梦均出自字节剪映团队。小云雀定位为一站式 AI 内容创作平台，今年 3 月上线短剧 Agent，支持上传最多 10 万字剧本、一键生成视频成片，搭载了字节自研的 Seedance 2.0 模型，在短剧、漫剧的标准化生产场景中具备从剧本解析到分镜生成的完整流程能力。 即梦 AI 于 2024 年 5 月推出，最初覆盖文生图、文生视频等生成能力，此后逐步向智能画布、首尾帧控制等偏专业创作的 Agent 编辑工具延伸，用户群体覆盖普通创作者与专业设计师。 IT之家注意到，两者在功能上存在重叠：都能在平台内完成“从生成到成片”的全流程，与剪映的剪辑环节形成平行的用户路径。
items.summary_en: ByteDance has folded its AI short-drama creation platform Xiaoyunque into its broader AI creation platform Jimeng, according to a 36Kr report, while keeping Xiaoyunque as a standalone entry point. The move is mainly a resource consolidation: Jimeng has absorbed Xiaoyunque's short-drama capabilities, and Xiaoyunque's operations now report to Jimeng's operations and marketing lead Chen Xinran, with the product team unchanged. Both products come from ByteDance's Jianying (CapCut) team and overlap in offering an end-to-end generation-to-finished-video workflow.
items.why_zh: 这显示字节跳动正在整合功能重叠的AI视频创作产品，以应对AI短剧这一快速升温的生成式内容赛道。
items.why_en: It shows ByteDance consolidating overlapping AI video-creation products as competition in AI-generated short dramas heats up.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 千亿融资逼近收官：结盟完美世界、中芯聚源等产业资本，募资翻倍押注具身智能 InfoQ-CN
items.summary_en: InfoQ China reports that DeepSeek's hundred-billion-scale round is nearing completion with industrial investors including Perfect World and SMIC Capital, and that the raise doubled its original target. Proceeds will focus on embodied AI, giving DeepSeek strategic ties across content and semiconductor supply chains.
items.why_zh: 募资翻倍且引入产业资本，显示资金正集中流向具身智能这一高投入赛道。
items.why_en: A doubled raise with industrial backers shows capital concentrating on embodied AI, a highly capital-intensive field.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek完成约千亿元融资，创中国AI行业最大融资纪录
items.title_en: DeepSeek Closes Roughly RMB 100 Billion Round, China's Largest AI Fundraise on Record
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek完成约千亿元融资，创中国AI行业最大融资纪录 21财经
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has completed a funding round of roughly RMB 100 billion, according to 21st Century Business Herald, making it the largest AI fundraise recorded in China. Details on investors, valuation and use of proceeds were not disclosed. The scale far exceeds earlier single rounds by Chinese large-model startups, underscoring continued investor appetite for leading model developers.
items.why_zh: 若属实，这将是迄今中国AI行业最大单笔融资，直接影响国内大模型竞争格局与资本流向。
items.why_en: If confirmed, it would be the largest single AI fundraise in China to date, reshaping the competitive landscape and capital flows in the country's LLM sector.

items.summary_en: Chinese AI model developer DeepSeek has reportedly raised about 100 billion yuan, with CATL, Tencent and Lenovo-affiliated investors participating, according to Jiemian-owned Guandian. Terms and valuation were not disclosed. If confirmed, it would rank among the largest fundraisings in China's large-model sector.
items.why_zh: 巨额融资显示产业资本与互联网巨头仍在加码基础大模型公司。
items.why_en: The mega-round shows industrial and internet giants are still betting heavily on foundation-model developers.

items.why_zh: 若融资消息属实，1000 亿元规模将创下国内大模型公司融资纪录，直接影响算力与人才投入的竞争格局。
items.why_en: If confirmed, a RMB 100 billion round would be a record for a Chinese model developer and reshape competition for compute and talent.

items.title_en: Tech Brief: RTX 5090 Scalped at RMB 60,000 on Shutdown Rumors; Xpeng Clarifies 'Laodeng' Remark; Claude Adds China Payment Options

Anthropic Claude 付款页面新增中国及港澳台地区选项，支持银联卡支付 据IT之家实测，中国大陆及港澳台地区已出现在 Anthropic 旗下 Claude 的付款页面中，支…
items.summary_en: A roundup of Oct 25 tech news: RTX 50-series channel prices in Huaqiangbei keep climbing despite Nvidia denying discontinuation rumors, with the RTX 5090 reportedly reaching RMB 60,000 amid GDDR7 memory shortages; an Xpeng VP clarified that a product manager's 'laodeng' remark referred to internal leads, not users; a tipster said some phone or tablet lines may be discontinued on cost pressure; and Anthropic's Claude checkout page now lists mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan with UnionPay support.
items.why_zh: 一条早报浓缩了显卡供应紧张、厂商产品线收缩与海外AI服务对华支付松动三条关键信号。
items.why_en: The briefing captures three key signals at once: GPU supply strain, shrinking hardware product lines, and loosening payment access to overseas AI services for Chinese users.

items.title_zh: Block发布Dessa语音AI：以真人语音训练，可在MacBook Pro本地运行
items.title_en: Block Unveils Dessa Voice AI Trained On Human Speech, Runs Locally On MacBook Pro: 10 outlets compared
items.summary_zh: Block推出名为Dessa的语音AI，据称其训练数据来自真人语音，并可在MacBook Pro上本地运行，无需依赖云端算力。相关报道汇集了10家媒体的对比评述，但公开信息尚未给出模型参数规模、延迟表现与具体可用范围等细节。若本地运行能力属实，这类方案有助于降低语音交互的部署成本，并缓解用户对语音数据上传云端的隐私顾虑，也顺应了端侧AI推理加速的趋势。
items.summary_en: Block Unveils Dessa Voice AI Trained On Human Speech, Runs Locally On MacBook Pro: 10 outlets compared NewsCord
items.why_zh: 语音模型能在笔记本本地跑通，意味着端侧AI交互在成本与隐私上迈出实用一步。
items.why_en: A voice model running locally on a laptop marks a practical step toward cheaper, more private on-device AI interaction.

items.title_zh: 《蓝色星球III》反其道而行：在AI时代保留“不完美”镜头
items.title_en: Blue Planet III is keeping the rough edges in the age of AI
items.summary_zh: BBC《蓝色星球III》选择以保留瑕疵画面的方式来证明自身真实性。该系列过往以近乎完美、晶莹剔透的画面著称，而在AI生成内容泛滥的当下，过度精致顺滑反而成了“AI感”的标志。执行制片人Elizabeth White此前对《卫报》表示，过去水中漂浮的大量浮游生物等元素会让他们剪掉某个镜头，或者会把船只、浮标框出画面之外；如今这些“不完美”被有意保留下来。这既是创作取向的调整，也折射出自然纪录片在AI时代重建观众信任的策略。
items.summary_en: BBC's Blue Planet III is looking to prove its authenticity by leaving in the less-than-perfect shots. Previous incarnations of the nature series were defined by their gorgeous, crystal-clear footage that seemed almost too good to be real. But one dead giveaway of AI is when things look too polished and seamless. To counter that, Blue Planet III goes warts and all. Executive Producer Elizabeth White told The Guardian in the past, "the amount of plankton and things" floating in the water would have caused them to cut a shot. Or "we might have framed out a boat or a buoy or gone: 'Oh, actually ……
items.why_zh: 当“太完美”成为AI内容的破绽，自然纪录片用保留瑕疵来重建观众信任，折射出AI时代的真实性焦虑。
items.why_en: When 'too perfect' signals AI generation, nature documentaries preserving flaws to win trust reveal the authenticity anxiety of the AI era.

items.title_zh: 得州总检察长Paxton起诉OpenAI与Sam Altman，寻求禁止儿童使用ChatGPT
items.title_en: Paxton Sues OpenAI And Sam Altman Over Suicide Claims, Seeks ChatGPT Ban For Texas Kids
items.summary_zh: 得克萨斯州总检察长 Ken Paxton 对 OpenAI 及其 CEO Sam Altman 提起诉讼，指控与自杀相关的问题，并请求法院禁止得州未成年人使用 ChatGPT。这起诉讼把AI聊天机器人与用户心理健康伤害的责任问题推上法庭，被告不仅包括公司，也直接指向其首席执行官个人。若诉求获支持，将对 ChatGPT 在得州的未成年人使用产生直接限制，并可能影响其他州的监管与诉讼走向。
items.summary_en: Paxton Sues OpenAI And Sam Altman Over Suicide Claims, Seeks ChatGPT Ban For Texas Kids Dallas Express
items.why_zh: 针对AI公司及其CEO的诉讼若推进，可能重塑聊天机器人在未成年人保护与产品责任方面的法律边界。
items.why_en: If it advances, the suit against an AI company and its CEO could reshape legal boundaries for chatbot liability and minor protection.

items.title_zh: 别只盯着Anthropic：生物科技正悄然主导IPO市场
items.title_en: Forget Anthropic: Biotech Is Quietly Dominating the IPO Sphere
items.summary_zh: 巴伦周刊文章指出，当市场目光集中在 Anthropic 等 AI 公司潜在的上市动作时，生物科技板块实际上正在悄然主导 IPO 市场。文章以“别只盯着 Anthropic”为切入点，提示投资者注意 AI 热潮之外的新股发行格局变化——生物科技企业在上市活动中占据了更突出的位置。这一视角提醒市场，AI 并非当下IPO舞台上唯一的主角。
items.summary_en: Forget Anthropic: Biotech Is Quietly Dominating the IPO Sphere Barron's
items.why_zh: 在AI叙事占据头条的当下，重新审视IPO市场的真实结构有助于投资者避免被单一热点牵引。
items.why_en: With AI dominating headlines, reassessing the IPO market's actual composition helps investors avoid being led by a single narrative.

items.title_zh: vLLM 称已追平 DeepSeek 自研引擎 DeepInfer 的性能曲线：decode 吞吐差距 6% 以内
items.title_en: vLLM Says It Has Matched DeepSeek's DeepInfer, With Decode Throughput Gap Under 6%
items.summary_zh: vLLM 称已追平 DeepSeek 自研引擎 DeepInfer 的性能曲线：decode 吞吐差距 6% 以内 智源社区
items.summary_en: Open-source inference framework vLLM says its performance curve has caught up with DeepSeek's in-house DeepInfer engine, with decode throughput trailing by no more than 6%. The comparison centers on decoding, the stage that most affects latency and cost in LLM serving, suggesting the efficiency gap between general-purpose frameworks and vendor-built engines is narrowing. Test conditions were not detailed.
items.why_zh: 通用开源框架逼近厂商自研推理引擎，意味着推理效率优势不再由少数厂商独占。
items.why_en: A general-purpose open-source framework nearing a vendor's proprietary engine means inference efficiency is no longer a moat held by a few players.

items.summary_zh: [流言板]父亲突发脑梗后儿子用豆包AI抢出救命时间 虎扑体育网
items.summary_en: A post on Hupu's rumor board describes how a user turned to ByteDance's Doubao AI assistant when his father suffered a sudden cerebral infarction, using it to get quick information and buy time before hospital treatment. The original post does not detail the AI's specific advice or the patient's later condition.
items.why_zh: 这类真实案例说明通用 AI 助手已开始进入普通人家庭应急决策的场景。
items.why_en: It shows general-purpose AI assistants are now reaching into real household emergency situations.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek新模型登场，用户要给AI付的钱又少了
items.title_en: DeepSeek's New Model Cuts the Cost of Using AI Again
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek新模型登场，用户要给AI付的钱又少了 36Kr
items.summary_en: 36Kr reports that DeepSeek has released a new model, continuing its low-price strategy and further lowering what users pay to run AI. The report frames cheaper inference as pressure on the broader model market, though specific pricing was not given in the headline or summary.
items.why_zh: 价格持续下探直接决定 AI 应用能否被大规模商用。
items.why_en: Falling inference prices are a key gate for large-scale commercial AI deployment.

items.title_zh: 行业第一！百度健康AI服务MAU超5000万，发布好医矩阵和健康相机
items.title_en: Baidu Health AI Tops 50M Monthly Users, Launches Doctor Matrix and Health Camera
items.summary_zh: 行业第一！百度健康AI服务MAU超5000万，发布好医矩阵和健康相机 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Baidu Health says its AI services now exceed 50 million monthly active users, which it calls an industry first, and has launched a "doctor matrix" and a "health camera" product. The move extends AI health from Q&A tools toward doctor-service networks and multimodal health recognition.
items.why_zh: 月活破 5000 万说明 AI 健康服务已具规模化用户基础，医疗成为大模型落地最快的高频场景之一。
items.why_en: Passing 50 million monthly users shows AI health services have reached real scale, making healthcare one of the fastest-adopted LLM use cases.

items.why_zh: 反映 AI 助手正被用于真实健康咨询场景，同时凸显其能力边界与风险。

items.summary_en: A Sina Finance report describes a man who described his father's sudden stroke symptoms to Doubao AI and rushed him to hospital overnight, crediting the assistant with helping secure timely treatment. items.why_zh: 真实急救案例展示了消费级 AI 助手在健康提示上的实际价值，也引发 AI 建议边界与责任归属的讨论。

items.why_en: Chinese models are now directly positioning against frontier overseas systems, intensifying competition.

items.why_zh: AI 助手原生上车正成为新车定价与配置竞争的新卖点。
items.why_en: Native AI assistant integration is becoming a new selling point in car pricing and feature competition.

items.title_zh: 研究：AI 玩《胡闹厨房》成绩惨淡，最强模型仅 26%
items.title_en: Research | AI struggles with Overcooked: Even the best model manages just 26 percent
items.summary_zh: Notebookcheck 报道了一项针对 AI 在合作类游戏《胡闹厨房》（Overcooked）中表现的研究。结果显示，即便是表现最好的模型，也只取得了 26% 的成绩，说明当前 AI 在这类需要实时协作、分工与动态规划的任务上仍明显吃力。游戏要求玩家在时间压力下协调动作、分配角色并应对不断变化的厨房环境。该结果提示，多智能体协作与长时序规划仍是当前模型的短板。
items.summary_en: Research | AI struggles with Overcooked: Even the best model manages just 26 percent Notebookcheck
items.why_zh: 合作类游戏是检验多智能体协作与实时规划能力的直观压力测试。
items.why_en: Cooperative games offer a clear stress test of multi-agent coordination and real-time planning.

items.title_zh: 小米 REDMI Book 2027 预热：外观焕新，16 英寸机型标配数字小键盘
items.title_en: Xiaomi Teases REDMI Book 2027: New Design, Numeric Keypad Standard on 16-Inch Model
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，小米 REDMI Book 2027 系列笔记本已经官宣将于 10 月 27 日发布。这款笔记本搭载第三代英特尔酷睿平台，内置 72Wh 电池，提供多彩配色，质感全面升级，主打移动办公。 小米产品行销总监、数码博主马志宇表示，REDMI Book 16 2027 在外观焕新的同时，还将加入用户长期反复提及的诉求 —— 数字小键盘。 当然，对于 16 英寸笔记本而言，数字小键盘并非技术难题，也不能严格称为优点或缺点，更多是产品定义上的取舍。 结合此前爆料，REDMI Book 16 2027 将搭载酷睿 5 320 处理器，并配备可自主更换的 DDR5 内存，不再延续前代内存板载的设计。 其他已确认或接近确认的信息包括：14 英寸版本采用 2.8K 分辨率屏幕，保留双 USB-A、双 USB-C、HDMI 和 3.5mm 耳机接口；全系内置超级小爱 2.0，支持跨设备协同和 AI 办公辅助。16 英寸版本的散热据爆料将升级为双风扇加 10mm 热管。 作为参考，2026 款 REDMI Book 14 的起售价为 6499 元（IT之家注：16GB+512GB），首销价曾下探至 5499 元，部分渠道在叠加国补后甚至达到了 4800 元区间。 相关阅读： 《 小米 REDMI Book 14 2027 笔记本“星云紫”亮相，10 月 27 日发布 》…
items.summary_en: Xiaomi will launch the REDMI Book 2027 series on October 27, featuring third-generation Intel Core platforms, a 72Wh battery and new colors. The 16-inch model adds a numeric keypad, reportedly pairs a Core 5 320 with replaceable DDR5 memory and dual-fan cooling, while the 14-inch version offers a 2.8K display; both include Super XiaoAi 2.0 for cross-device and AI office features.
items.why_zh: 数字小键盘与可换内存等调整，显示小米在主流轻薄本上正回应真实用户需求。
items.why_en: The keypad and replaceable memory show Xiaomi responding to real user demands in mainstream laptops.

items.title_zh: 研究人员通过 DNS 数据库发现数千个公开的 Muse 聊天记录分享链接，Meta 已修复
items.title_en: Thousands of Shared Muse Chat Links Were Discoverable via DNS, Meta Says It Fixed the Issue
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，Meta 旗下个人 AI 助手 Muse 的对话分享功能被曝存在隐私风险。 网络安全研究团队 Claroc 于 10 月 18 日发布报告称，研究人员通过被动 DNS（Passive DNS）查询发现，超过 6800 个 Muse 分享页面的域名可以被检索到，部分页面包含个人财务资料、企业内部文件及机密会议准备信息。Meta 随后暂停了该功能，并表示正在调查问题及评估改进方案。 Claroc 研究团队发现，Muse 会根据用户分享的对话标题生成网页地址，并将其部署在 cf.metaaiusercontent.com 域名下。由于对话标题被写入子域名，当用户或接收者访问分享页面时，相关域名可能被被动 DNS 服务记录，进而出现在可查询的历史 DNS 数据库中。 研究人员表示，通过一次被动 DNS 查询，他们便发现了超过 6800 个分享页面的主机名。Claroc 随后抽查了数百个页面，发现其中部分内容涉及企业营收审查文件、小企业贷款申请、银行欺诈警报、房地产投资数据，以及员工年度休假安排等敏感信息。研究人员还发现，一名候选人为与一家前沿 AI 实验室负责人进行机密电话沟通准备的材料，其中包含内部联系人信息和会议时间。 Claroc 指出，相关页面无需登录 Meta 账号即可访问，只要能够获得对应链接即可查看内容。问题并非源于攻击者破解了随机生成的标识…
items.summary_en: Security researchers at Claroc found that more than 6,800 shared Muse conversation pages could be discovered through passive DNS lookups, because share links were built from conversation titles as subdomains. Sampled pages contained corporate revenue reviews, loan applications, fraud alerts and other sensitive material, accessible without logging in. Meta paused the feature and said it is investigating.
items.why_zh: AI 助手的分享功能若设计不当，可能把私密对话变成可被搜索的公开数据。
items.why_en: Poorly designed AI sharing features can turn private conversations into publicly discoverable data.

items.title_en: BYD Establishes Hong Kong Smart Transportation Subsidiary, Plans to Introduce SkyShuttle

items.summary_en: BYD announced the establishment of BYD Smart Transportation (Hong Kong) Ltd. in Hong Kong, based at the Science Park in Pak Shek Kok, to promote its SkyShuttle rail system. SkyShuttle is a low-capacity, elevated, autonomous transit system designed for hilly terrain, with a maximum speed of 80 km/h and capacity of up to 560 passengers per train. The move responds to Hong Kong’s push for smart green mass transit.

items.why_en: BYD is entering Hong Kong public transit with SkyShuttle, offering a new low-capacity rail option for dense, hilly cities.

Each earbud weighs 5.3g, and the product supports left-right agnostic charging. Pricing has not been announced; Xiaomi’s first clip-style earbuds launched in May at 799 yuan.
items.why_zh: Redmi切入耳夹耳机市场，并把端侧AI语音助手作为差异化卖点。
items.why_en: Redmi is entering the ear-clip market and using an on-device AI voice assistant as a differentiator.

items.title_en: CAICT: About 15 million passenger cars in China had NOA as of August
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，据中国信通院，2026 世界智能网联汽车大会已于 10 月 21 日至 23 日在北京亦庄举办。在全体大会成果发布环节，工业和信息化部装备工业一司司长郭守刚介绍了国家车联网技术标准体系与 跨标委 合作机制，发布《国家车联网技术标准体系建设指南（2026 版）》（征求意见稿），并主持车联网标准跨标委合作协议签署仪式。 会上介绍，中国先后制定发布组合驾驶辅助系统、自动驾驶系统、自动紧急制动系统、整车信息安全等多项重要国家标准。截至今年 8 月，国内约 6100 万辆乘用车搭载组合驾驶辅助（L2）功能， 其中约 1500 万辆乘用车具备领航驾驶辅助（ NOA ）功能 。 IT之家从公告获悉，目前，中国已制定发布 C-V2X 直连通信与 5G 蜂窝通信技术系列标准，并依托“四跨”等应用实践活动，合力推动网联通信应用走向规模化。截至今年 8 月， 约 1600 万辆乘用车装配 5G 终端 、200 万辆乘用车装配 C-V2X 终端。 会上提到，道路交通系统是智能网联汽车的运行载体。智能交通、车辆智能管理领域一批支撑标准的陆续发布，有力支撑了高速公路、城市道路等路侧基础设施智能化改造、网联化升级，开展道路通行规定符合性测试，提升车路协同服务和交通管理能力。 此外，车联网平台汇聚车、路、云产业链多方主体。车联网平台技术要求及平台安全等标准的发布与实施，为支撑智能…
items.summary_en: At the 2026 World Intelligent Connected Vehicle Conference, MIIT released a draft national vehicle networking standards guide and signed cross-committee cooperation agreements. As of August, about 61 million passenger cars in China had L2 combined driving assistance, including about 15 million with NOA; about 16 million had 5G terminals and 2 million had C-V2X terminals. China has issued standards covering driver assistance, autonomous driving, automatic emergency braking, vehicle cybersecurity, C-V2X and 5G communications.
items.why_zh: 显示中国智能驾驶与车联网功能正规模化渗透，也为标准制定和产业化提供依据。
items.why_en: It shows the large-scale adoption of smart driving and connected-car features in China, supporting standards and industrialization.

items.summary_zh: 据 AZ Family 报道，一起涉及 OpenAI 的监听设备案件引发外界对 AI 实验室安全性的关注。标题未披露案件的具体细节与调查进展，但事件已将 AI 公司的办公与研发环境安全推到聚光灯下。对 AI 实验室而言，物理安全、内部访问控制与敏感信息保护可能成为后续讨论重点。

items.summary_en: According to 21 Finance, multiple apps have rejected the Doubao phone assistant, and financial institutions are saying no to external AI agents. The report points to resistance when phone AI assistants try to operate across apps or enter financial scenarios. The case highlights permission, security and compliance barriers facing external agents in existing app ecosystems.

items.why_en: Phone AI assistants face ecosystem barriers and compliance caution from financial institutions when operating across apps.

items.why_zh: 折射高校课堂对AI工具的态度从试验走向谨慎与政策收紧。

items.title_zh: 开发者成功为小米 8 手机刷入苹果 iOS 16.5 系统，将机型伪装为 iPhone X
items.title_en: Developer installs iOS 16.5 on Xiaomi 8, spoofs it as iPhone X
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，随着 AI 技术突飞猛进，许多开发者在大模型辅助加持之下对各种老旧机型进行折腾，先前便有 开发者为小米 Redmi Note 12 4G 手机刷入 iOS 系统，并开源了项目 。 IT之家注意到，目前又有开发者 Yanei 发布视频，展示其成功为一部小米 8 手机刷入 iOS 16.5 系统，参考其发布的视频，可以看到该开发者将设备机型伪装为 iPhone X，系统元素在小米 8 手机上呈现良好。 该网友在视频简介和评论区中表示，小米 8 和当年的 iPhone X 真的太像了，运行起来颇有当年的感觉，最初 GPU 存在卡顿情况，后续经过修复后流畅了不少。 目前，系统桌面显示和动画已经比较流畅，不过项目整体仍处于早期移植阶段，很多硬件驱动还需要继续适配，暂时不能作为日常系统使用。 公开信息显示，小米 8 于 2018 年 5 月 31 日推出，该机采用 6.21 英寸三星 AMOLED 异型全面屏（刘海屏），机身背部采用四曲面玻璃设计，配合 7 系铝金属中框，搭载了高通骁龙 845 移动平台，内置 3400mAh 电池。
items.summary_en: Developer Yanei has posted a video showing iOS 16.5 running on a Xiaomi 8, with the device spoofed as an iPhone X. The developer says initial GPU stutter was largely fixed and the home screen and animations are now fairly smooth, but the project remains an early port with many hardware drivers still needing work and is not ready for daily use. The Xiaomi 8 launched in May 2018 with a 6.21-inch AMOLED notch display, Snapdragon 845 and 3,400mAh battery.
items.why_zh: 体现开发者社区对跨系统移植的持续探索，也提示早期移植在驱动与稳定性上的挑战。
items.why_en: It shows ongoing community efforts in cross-platform OS porting and the driver and stability challenges of early builds.

items.title_zh: 小鹏汽车官宣在欧洲四国实现累计销量破万，覆盖丹麦、挪威、法国、德国
items.title_en: XPeng Hits 10,000 Cumulative Sales in Four European Countries, With G6 and G9 Topping Local Segments
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，小鹏汽车官方昨日宣布，在欧洲四国（丹麦、挪威、法国、德国）实现了累计销量破万， 同时小鹏 G6 和 G9 也多次获得了当地销量第一 。 据IT之家此前报道，在小鹏 G9L 巴黎车展全球上市发布会上，小鹏集团董事长、CEO 何小鹏表示，2026 年上半年，小鹏在法国的销量位居中国新势力品牌第一。何小鹏还表示， 目标是到 2030 年底全球年销量达到 100 万辆，其中欧洲占一半 。 值得一提的是，欧洲本地首台小鹏 G9L 已于 10 月 7 日在麦格纳奥地利工厂顺利完成试制。小鹏集团还当选了联合国欧洲经济委员会（UNECE）GRVA / WP.29 框架下，新设的“自动驾驶场景相关信息交换工作组”（TF-ESRI）秘书长。 这也是中国企业首次在联合国自动驾驶法规核心框架下担任秘书长 。 延伸阅读 据小鹏汽车公布的细分市场数据，小鹏 G6 在丹麦成为 2026 年中国纯电车型销量第一，在法国、德国获得 2026 年第三季度中国新势力纯电中型 SUV 销量榜首；小鹏 G9 则在挪威获得 2026 年中国新势力纯电中大型 SUV 销量第一。 小鹏汽车的出海布局最早自挪威开启，目前海外市场业务已扩展至数十个国家和地区。官方数据显示，其海外累计交付量已超过 10 万台，其中欧洲市场贡献约 60% 的份额；2026 年第二季度海外单季销量首次突破 2 万台，同比…
items.summary_en: XPeng said cumulative sales in Denmark, Norway, France and Germany have passed 10,000 units, with the G6 and G9 repeatedly ranking first in local segments. The company says overseas deliveries now exceed 100,000 units, about 60% of them in Europe, and that a locally built G9L completed a trial build at Magna's Austrian plant.
items.why_zh: 这是中国新势力车企在欧洲从“试水”走向规模化的重要信号，也关系到其本地化生产与全球百万销量目标的落地。
items.why_en: It signals that a Chinese EV startup is moving from testing the waters to real scale in Europe, a key step toward its local production plans and global sales goals.

items.summary_zh: 腾讯WorkBuddy接入Kimi K3.1 Pro：3万亿参数、100万上下文 凤凰网
items.summary_en: Tencent's WorkBuddy has integrated Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro, a model with roughly 3 trillion parameters and a 1-million-token context window, according to ifeng. The move gives WorkBuddy users access to a domestic model designed for very long documents and complex tasks.
items.why_zh: 头部互联网产品接入超大参数、超长上下文国产模型，说明国内大模型竞争正从“发榜”转向真实产品与工作流落地。
items.why_en: A major internet product adopting a huge-context domestic model shows China's LLM race shifting from benchmark releases to real product and workflow deployment.

items.summary_en: Phoenix Tech reports that Tencent's WorkBuddy now integrates Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro, a model with 3 trillion-level parameters and a 1 million token context window. The integration brings the domestic model into office collaboration workflows, though pricing and rollout details were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 头部办公工具接入超长上下文国产模型，意味着大模型竞争正转向应用入口。
items.why_en: A major office tool adopting a long-context domestic model shows competition shifting to application entry points.

items.summary_zh: 腾讯WorkBuddy正式接入Kimi K3.1 Pro，同步上线高速版模型 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Tencent WorkBuddy has officially integrated Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro and launched a high-speed variant of the model alongside it, according to Sohu. The pairing lets users choose between stronger reasoning and faster responses depending on the task.
items.why_zh: 同时提供“旗舰版+高速版”的双模型配置，反映出 AI 产品在能力与成本、延迟之间做工程化取舍的普遍趋势。
items.why_en: Offering both a flagship and a high-speed model reflects the broader industry trade-off between capability, cost and latency in AI products.

items.title_zh: 腾讯WorkBuddy正式接入Kimi K3.1 Pro，同步上线高速版模型
items.title_en: Tencent WorkBuddy Integrates Kimi K3.1 Pro and Adds a High-Speed Model Version
items.summary_zh: 腾讯WorkBuddy正式接入Kimi K3.1 Pro，同步上线高速版模型 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Tencent's WorkBuddy has officially integrated the Kimi K3.1 Pro model and simultaneously rolled out a high-speed model option. The move brings an external vendor's model into the product, letting users trade off capability against response speed. Pricing, context length and rollout scope were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 办公类AI产品引入外部模型并区分能力档与速度档，反映多模型接入正成为行业常规做法。
items.why_en: Bringing in an outside model with capability and speed tiers shows multi-model integration is becoming standard for workplace AI products.

items.title_zh: 3万亿级参数规模 全球最大开源AI大模型上新
items.title_en: World's Largest Open-Source AI Model, at 3-Trillion-Parameter Scale, Gets an Update
items.summary_zh: 3万亿级参数规模 全球最大开源AI大模型上新 中国新闻网
items.summary_en: China News Service reports a new release of an open-source AI model at the 3-trillion-parameter scale, described as the largest open-source model update globally. Such scale typically brings stronger general capability but also higher inference and deployment costs.
items.why_zh: 开源模型参数规模跃升到 3 万亿级，将直接影响企业自建与二次开发的门槛与选择。
items.why_en: Pushing open-source models to the 3-trillion-parameter scale directly affects the cost and options for companies building on or self-hosting them.

items.why_zh: 融资进展关系到 DeepSeek 在算力与模型迭代上的持续投入能力。
items.why_en: Funding progress bears directly on DeepSeek's ability to keep investing in compute and model iteration.

items.why_zh: 在经历一段发布低谷后，头部模型的迭代节奏恢复，会重新影响开发者与企业的模型选型。
items.why_en: After a quiet stretch, renewed iteration from a leading Chinese lab reshapes how developers and enterprises choose their models.

items.why_en: Coding is one of the most important real-world uses of LLMs, so open-source leaderboard standings directly influence developers' tooling choices.

items.summary_en: Zhidongxi reports that Moonshot released Kimi K3.1 with 3 trillion-level parameters, claiming the top spot among domestic models while pricing at roughly one-fifth of rival Astra. Hands-on tests reportedly completed 3D modeling tasks, though exact benchmark scores were not included.
items.why_zh: 以数万亿参数配合低价策略，直接冲击高端模型的性价比格局。
items.why_en: Trillion-scale parameters paired with low pricing directly reshape the price-performance landscape for frontier models.

items.title_en: Kimi Releases Its Strongest 3-Trillion-Parameter Model, Topping GPT-6 on Coding Agent Tests
items.summary_zh: Kimi最强3万亿级模型来了！编程智能体测评超过GPT-6，3D建模与金融能力升级，11月4日前开放权重 华尔街见闻
items.summary_en: Wallstreetcn reports that Moonshot released its strongest model yet, with 3 trillion-level parameters, claiming it outperforms GPT-6 on coding-agent benchmarks while upgrading 3D modeling and financial capabilities. Model weights are said to be opened before November 4.
items.why_zh: 编程智能体是当前大模型最关键的高价值场景，直接对标 GPT-6 具有标志意义。
items.why_en: Coding agents are a key high-value use case, making a direct claim against GPT-6 notable.
